releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.1 (Build 78):
• Liquid Glass Optics Refinement: Pristine continuous specular meniscus reflections with zero color banding or dithering artifacts.
• Native Vector Sharpness: Removed GPU layer promotion overrides, restoring native Retina/AMOLED subpixel vector crispness across all cards and typography.
• Pure iOS Calendar Architecture: Removed circular badge containers in favor of Apple iOS native dark typography, proportional squircle day cells, and 6px high-contrast micro-dots.
• Mobile Viewport & Dynamic Island Geometry: Dynamic safe-area top clearance (+52px fallback) completely clearing camera hole-punches, speaker grilles, and Dynamic Island.
